name: Board Office
description: The organisational department responsible for the ownership and maintenance of the Governance Framework Overview document.

name: Board
description: The highest governance body of FirstUK Bank, responsible for providing strategic direction and risk oversight.
context: Board provides strategic direction and risk oversight
Defined responsibilities at each level (Board, Executive, Managers)

name: Executive
description: The executive management level of the bank with defined responsibilities as part of the governance framework.
context: Defined responsibilities at each level (Board, Executive, Managers)

name: Managers
description: The management level of the bank with defined responsibilities as part of the governance framework.
context: Defined responsibilities at each level (Board, Executive, Managers)

name: Risk Committee
description: A governance committee tasked with providing independent assurance and challenge to the bank's risk management.
context: Risk and Audit committees provide independent assurance

name: Audit Committee
description: A governance committee tasked with providing independent assurance and challenge to the bank's internal controls and audits.
context: Risk and Audit committees provide independent assurance

name: FCA Regulatory Requirements
description: The regulatory requirements set forth by the Financial Conduct Authority that FirstUK Bank is committed to fully complying with.
context: Full compliance with FCA, PRA, and legal requirements

name: PRA Regulatory Requirements
description: The regulatory requirements set forth by the Prudential Regulation Authority that FirstUK Bank is committed to fully complying with.
context: Full compliance with FCA, PRA, and legal requirements

name: Board Composition — Target 5–7 Directors
description: The target number of directors for the Board of Directors is set between 5 and 7, aligned with FCA guidance.

name: FCA Guidance on Board Composition
description: Regulatory guidance provided by the FCA regarding the appropriate number of directors for the bank's Board.

name: Board Approval of Business Strategy
description: The Board is responsible for the formal approval of the bank's overall business strategy.

name: Board Approval of Annual Budget and Capital Plan
description: The Board holds the authority to approve the annual budget and the associated capital plan.
context: Approve annual budget and capital plan

name: Board Approval of Material Acquisitions and Disposals
description: The Board is responsible for approving any material acquisitions or disposals of assets.

name: Board Setting of Risk Appetite
description: The Board is tasked with the formal setting of the bank's risk appetite.

name: Board Approval of Policies and Procedures
description: The Board is responsible for the approval of the bank's internal policies and procedures.

name: Board Approval of Committee Charters
description: The Board is responsible for the approval of charters governing the bank's committees.

name: Board Appointment of Executives
description: The Board is responsible for the formal appointment of the bank's executive leadership.

name: Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank responsible for strategic, governance, risk, and stakeholder oversight.

name: Board Meeting Minutes Approval Process
description: The formal requirement that Board meeting minutes must be approved and retained as a permanent record to ensure governance accountability.

name: Board Risk Committee
description: A board-level committee responsible for overseeing risk strategy, appetite, capital adequacy, audit findings, and regulatory compliance. The committee meets on a quarterly basis.
context: Responsibilities: Risk strategy and appetite, Capital adequacy, Audit findings, Regulatory compliance

name: Board Audit Committee
description: A quarterly meeting body composed primarily of Independent Non-Executive Directors responsible for internal and external audit oversight, financial reporting, and the control environment.
context: Responsibilities: Internal audit oversight, External audit coordination, Financial reporting, Control environment

name: Board Remuneration Committee
description: A board-level committee responsible for executive compensation, staff incentive schemes, and the management of conflicts of interest. The committee meets on a quarterly basis and is composed primarily of Independent Non-Executive Directors (NEDs).
context: Responsibilities: Executive compensation, Staff incentive schemes, Conflict of interest management

name: Chief Executive Officer
description: The executive responsible for chief executive responsibility, business performance, regulatory interface, and crisis management. The role reports directly to the Board.

name: Board
description: The primary governance body to which the Chief Executive Officer reports.

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: The executive function responsible for financial management, reporting, treasury, funding, capital management, and investment decisions. This role reports directly to the CEO and the Board.

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: The executive responsible for enterprise risk management, capital and liquidity management, risk policy approval, and regulatory compliance oversight. The role reports functionally to the Board Risk Committee and administratively to the CEO.
context: Reports to: Board Risk Committee (functionally), CEO (administratively)

name: Board Risk Committee
description: The governance body to which the Chief Risk Officer reports functionally.

name: Chief Operating Officer
description: The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for business operations, process management, operational efficiency, and customer service, reporting directly to the CEO.

name: Business Operations
description: The operational area of the bank under the authority of the Chief Operating Officer.

name: Chief Technology Officer
description: The Chief Technology Officer is responsible for technology strategy, infrastructure, system availability, security, investment decisions, and cybersecurity. The role reports directly to the CEO.

name: Technology Department
description: The organizational unit responsible for technology strategy, infrastructure, and cybersecurity, led by the CTO.

name: Chief Information Security Officer
description: The executive responsible for information security policy, cybersecurity incident response, data protection, and security risk assessment. The role reports functionally to the CTO and to the Board Risk Committee for security risk matters.
context: Reports to: CTO (functionally), Board Risk Committee (for security risk)

name: Board Risk Committee
description: The governance body to which the Chief Information Security Officer reports specifically regarding security risk.

name: Chief Technology Officer
description: The executive to whom the Chief Information Security Officer reports functionally.

name: Business Units
description: The first line of defense responsible for day-to-day risk management, daily monitoring, escalation, and the ownership of their own controls.

name: Risk & Compliance
description: The second line of defense providing independent risk oversight, compliance testing, control design review, and key control monitoring.

name: Internal Audit
description: The third line of defense providing independent assurance through a risk-based annual audit plan, finding identification, and follow-up, reporting directly to the Board Audit Committee.

name: Board Audit Committee
description: The governance body to which the Internal Audit function reports its findings and assurance activities.

name: Board Risk Committee Charter
description: The formal charter governing the Board Risk Committee, defining its mandate and governance responsibilities within the bank's corporate governance framework.

name: Internal Audit Charter
description: The formal charter establishing the Internal Audit function, outlining its authority, scope, and independence within the organization.

name: Corporate Organizational Model
description: The approved organizational structure defining the hierarchy and reporting lines of FirstUK Bank.

name: Operational Risk
description: Operational risk as governed by the Operational Risk Policy.

name: Risk Appetite Statement 2026
description: The formal Risk Appetite Statement for the year 2026 defining the bank's risk tolerance.

name: Anti-Money Laundering Risk
description: AML risk as governed by the Anti-Money Laundering Policy.

name: Customer Identification (KYC) Policy
description: The bank's internal policy governing customer identification and Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements.

name: Privacy and Data Protection (GDPR) Policy
description: The bank's internal policy regarding privacy and data protection, specifically aligned with GDPR requirements.

name: Complaint Handling Policy
description: The bank's internal policy defining the procedures for handling customer complaints.

name: Escalation Matrix Operational Procedures
description: Formal operational procedures defining the escalation matrix for the bank's risk and governance framework.

name: Incident Response Plan Operational Procedures
description: Formal operational procedures outlining the incident response plan for managing and mitigating operational disruptions.

name: Information Security Risk
description: Risk area governed by the Information Security Policy, focusing on the protection of the bank's information assets and systems.

name: Fraud Risk
description: Risk area governed by the Fraud Prevention Policy, focusing on the detection and prevention of fraudulent activities within the bank.

name: FCA Conduct of Business Sourcebook (COBS)
description: The Conduct of Business (COBS) framework established by the Financial Conduct Authority governing how the bank conducts its business with customers.

name: FCA Systems and Controls Sourcebook (SYSC)
description: The Systems and Controls (SYSC) framework established by the Financial Conduct Authority regarding the bank's internal governance and control structures.

name: FCA Dispute Resolution Sourcebook (DISP)
description: The Dispute Resolution (DISP) framework established by the Financial Conduct Authority governing the handling of customer complaints.

name: FCA Supervision Sourcebook (SUP)
description: The Supervision (SUP) framework established by the Financial Conduct Authority regarding the bank's supervisory obligations.

name: Customer Identification and KYC Risk
description: Compliance risk associated with the requirement for proper customer identification and Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures.

name: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Risk
description: Compliance risk associated with the bank's obligations to prevent money laundering activities.

name: Fair Treatment and Complaints Risk
description: Risk related to the fair treatment of customers and the effective management of customer complaints.

name: Market Conduct Risk
description: Risk associated with the bank's adherence to market conduct standards and regulations.

name: Financial Crime Prevention Risk
description: Broad risk category encompassing the bank's ability to prevent and detect financial crime.

name: Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) Rulebook
description: The regulatory framework established by the Prudential Regulation Authority covering capital adequacy, risk management, operational resilience, and liquidity management.

name: Capital Adequacy Risk
description: Risk associated with maintaining sufficient capital to cover potential losses, governed under Pillar 1 of the PRA Rulebook.

name: Risk Management Governance Risk
description: Risk related to the bank's internal risk management frameworks and governance structures as defined under Pillar 2.

name: Operational Resilience Risk
description: Risk concerning the bank's ability to prevent, adapt to, and recover from operational disruptions, governed under Pillar 2.

name: Liquidity Management Risk
description: Risk associated with the bank's ability to meet its financial obligations as they fall due.

name: Minimum Capital Ratios
description: Quantitative compliance requirement for the minimum amount of capital the bank must hold relative to its risk-weighted assets.

name: System Availability (RTO/RPO)
description: Quantitative metrics for Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) to ensure operational resilience.

name: Compliance Department
description: The department responsible for compliance monitoring, regulatory engagement, and reporting to the FCA and PRA.

name: FCA/PRA Supervisory Engagement Framework
description: The established framework for engagement with designated FCA/PRA supervisors, including quarterly meetings and annual reporting requirements.
context: Annual Reporting: Compliance data to FCA

name: Annual Compliance Data Reporting to FCA
description: A recurring requirement to provide compliance data to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) on an annual basis.
context: Annual Reporting: Compliance data to FCA

name: Voluntary Breach Reporting
description: The process of self-disclosing regulatory breaches to the supervisory authorities.

name: Compliance Dashboard Key Metrics
description: A set of key metrics monitored on a monthly basis via the Compliance dashboard to track ongoing adherence to regulatory and internal standards.

name: Quarterly Risk Committee Review
description: A formal quarterly governance process where the Risk Committee reviews risk profiles and management approaches.

name: Semi-Annual Control Testing Audit
description: A semi-annual audit process focused on control testing to identify gaps or strengths in the bank's operational environment.

name: Annual Full Governance Review
description: A comprehensive annual review of the bank's governance framework to ensure effectiveness and alignment with regulatory expectations.

name: Internal Audit
description: The internal audit function responsible for the annual audit plan and quarterly reporting.
context: Internal Audit: Annual audit plan, quarterly reporting

name: External Audit
description: The external audit entity responsible for conducting the annual financial audit.

name: Regulatory Audit
description: The regulatory audit function involving periodic examinations by the FCA and PRA.

name: Conflicts of Interest Risk
description: Risk associated with ethics and conflicts of interest, managed through a formal policy requiring declarations, regular reviews, and escalation procedures.

name: All Staff and Directors
description: The group of bank employees and directors required to submit declarations under the Conflict of Interest Policy.

name: Ethics Standards and Customer Interest Risk
description: The bank's framework for ensuring all decisions are made in the customer's best interest, preventing conflicts of interest, and maintaining transparency and fair dealing with stakeholders.
context: All decisions made in customer's best interest

name: Regulatory Circulars
description: Updates on regulatory changes provided via regulatory circulars as part of the bank's external reporting and transparency framework.
context: Regulatory Circulars: Updates on regulatory changes

name: Board
description: The primary governance body receiving quarterly financial, risk, and governance reports.

name: Board Approval of Document Sign-Off
description: Formal approval and sign-off of the document granted by the Board of Directors and the Company Secretary on 2026-01-15.
context: Approved by: Board of Directors — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Board of Directors
description: The primary governing body of FirstUK Bank responsible for the final approval and sign-off of the document.
